glyph.isekai_mahou.atomic.desc: I AM ATOMIC: for 3 seconds you float, blue-violet rings form in layers and the words "I... ...am..." appear; then a blue-violet dome expands from the hit point (radius 14 + 6 per Expand, × power, up to 56): massive armor-piercing damage, a shockwave ring, a mushroom cloud and a giant crater. Anyone nearby gets a "Take cover!" warning. You, allied players (no PvP: everyone), companions, summons and tamed pets stay in a blue BUBBLE: no damage, no knockback and, if the ground vanishes, they float for 3 s and drift down slowly. Can be countered while charging.
glyph.isekai_mahou.disintegration.desc: A cylinder of holy circles traps the target (or area). 1.5 s later pure light disintegrates everyone inside: 40% of max health (bosses 12%) + 20 × power, ignoring armor. The terrain in the cylinder is erased up to the sky.
glyph.isekai_mahou.time_stop.desc: Ultimate (G). A wave of inverted colors spreads (radius 48) and EVERYTHING stops for 3 s (+1 s per Extend, +1 s at Circle 8; max 9 s): creatures, projectiles, items, falling blocks. Your projectiles freeze mid-air after 0.5 s. Damage dealt to frozen targets is stored and lands all at once when time resumes, together with the spell's effects on every frozen enemy.
glyph.isekai_mahou.goatify.desc: Turns a common creature into a goat for 20 s. If the goat dies, the creature dies too (with loot). Bosses resist. Players get the Goat Curse.
effect.isekai_mahou.time_stopped.descrip: Time has stopped for you: no walking, jumping, attacking, using items or casting.
effect.isekai_mahou.goat_curse.descripti: You are a goat. No attacking or casting, you jump high and scream.
legend.isekai_mahou.i_am_atomic.desc: You float, atomic rings spin in layers and, after "I... ...am...", your own body becomes the center of a blue-violet dome that erases everything around. Your friends stay safe in a blue bubble. Spends all your mana.
legend.isekai_mahou.all_range_atomic.des: The all-range version: the dome reaches its maximum size and leaves a colossal crater. Your friends stay safe in a blue bubble. Spends all your mana.
legend.isekai_mahou.disintegration.desc: A fast homing projectile locks the target in a cylinder of holy circles; pure light disintegrates it and erases the terrain up to the sky.
legend.isekai_mahou.the_world.desc: "Time, stop!": everything stops. When time resumes, conjured blades and all the stored damage land on your enemies at once.
legend.isekai_mahou.goat_curse.desc: A homing projectile turns the target into a goat for longer. If the goat dies, so does the target.
message.isekai_mahou.legends_d.goat_curs: You turned into a goat! Baaaa!
hud.isekai_mahou.legends_d.take_cover_sa: You're an ally: the blue bubble will protect you. Stay calm!
hud.isekai_mahou.legends_d.take_cover_ru: Get out of the radius! %s more blocks.
hud.isekai_mahou.legends_d.take_cover_ou: You're outside the radius — stay away!
effect.isekai_mahou.atomic_bubble.descri: Protected by an ally's Atomic bubble: no blast damage, no knockback, no gravity (you float if the ground vanishes) and a slow descent at the end.
